title: CI pipeline critical-path bottleneck
what: integration-shard-3 duration (min or s), share of 14-min build, or idle wait over other shards

reader_questions.question: Which job is the critical-path bottleneck and how long does it run?
reader_questions.expected: integration-shard-3 runs 9.75 min (585 s), accounting for 69.6% of the 14.0-min build.

reader_questions.question: Is this a single pipeline run or an average across runs?
reader_questions.expected: It is a single deterministic workflow run (run 9482710), so timings are exact observed durations.

reader_questions.question: How much faster could the build finish if integration-shard-3 matched the next slowest shard?
reader_questions.expected: About 5.4 min faster (other shards finish in 3.8–4.3 min, blocking package-artifacts for 5.4 min).
